Freelance AI & automation job market: who's buying, what they need, what it pays

What to do with this: recommendations for an AI-agents / automation / RAG / SaaS freelancer ($35/h, $3k fixed floors)

    Every number here comes from the cleaned dataset. Full reasoning is in INSIGHTS.md. The recommendations are static; the charts below respond to the filters.

    Opportunity ranking for your stack

    freelance marketplaces · groups with at least 40 jobs · Spark-computed · not filter-driven
    Score (0-100) = 25% volume + 25% share of jobs at or above your floor ($35/h or $3k fixed, Upwork where available) + 10% hourly rate + 15% low competition (median Freelancer/PPH bids) + 5% growth (Freelancer share, Aug-Oct 2026 vs Nov 2025-Jan 2026) + 20% fit to your stack.

    Monthly postings by source

    Upwork and most job boards list only open jobs, so their volume is concentrated in the last 1-3 months and is not a trend. Freelancer.com's API also returns closed and awarded projects, so it is the only trend source. But 22 of its 58 queries hit the 2,000-result cap and kept only recent projects, which inflates Aug-Oct. The 'fully-collected queries' line (the 36 uncapped queries) is the unbiased trend sample.

    Trend: share of Freelancer.com postings (fully-collected queries), top subtypes in current filter

    Share of each month's Freelancer postings, so total-volume swings are normalised away. October 2026 is a partial month.
